name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A circular image with a text fallback. Wraps @base-ui/react/avatar: Base UI owns the image load/error state machine that decides when the fallback shows, and we own the surface.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/avatar

Installed to `components/ui/avatar.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/avatar

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
